label: early copy-phase recall in long sequences, favoring re-input c/w/z/2/t
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (100% of mass; never in the original phase or on <DEL>, never on the first occurrence of a token). Concentrated on early recall positions (recall_idx 2-4 hold ~88% of mass, peak at 3) in long sequences (L=9 holds 66% of mass, L<=5 essentially never), with a small secondary bump at the last recall steps of L=9 (t=17). Within those positions it prefers when the fed-back input is c, w, z, digit 2 or t (in_tok lift 2-6x); the largest activations are mostly on w/c/2 at recall_idx 2-3, often in sequences starting with h. The token preference is soft: many activations are on other tokens and many c/w/z/2/t steps in the window are inactive, so precision and recall both stay around 0.4-0.5 on dev (mass recall ~0.58). Position alone (copy, recall 2-4, L>=8) reaches ~0.79 mass recall at only ~0.10 precision.
